literal_meaning: সীমা (boundary) এবং পরিসীমা (extent or circumference) এর সমন্বয়
figurative_meaning_bn: একার্থক সহচর শব্দ; ইয়ত্তা, সীমা, অবধি
figurative_meaning_en: synonymous pair denoting limit, boundary, or extent; often implying utmost or boundless degree
example_sentences_in_english: There is no limit to the joy.
note: This is a pleonastic or tautological expression used for emphasis in Bengali rhetoric, common in literature and speech.
